newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK GOVT APPROVES 20 PCT POSTAL PRICE HIKE.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK GOVT APPROVES 20 PCT POSTAL PRICE HIKE.

text.p: The Slovak government said on Tuesday it had approved a 20 percent increase in prices of basic services provided by the state-owned postal monopoly Slovenska Posta s.p (SP), effective April 1.

"The original proposal drafted by our ministry called for a 31 percent price hike, but the government reduced it to 20 percent," Post Minister Alexander Rezes told a news conference after a regular government meeting.
Rezes said the increase will help SP increase reveneues at a time when it is in a critical financial situation.
According to preliminary calculation, SP broke even last year, but is expected to post an 87 million crown gross loss in 1997 after a planned six percent pay rise.
Prices of mail services in Slovakia are regulated by the state. The last government-approved increase was in 1992.
